description: This Java source file defines a custom runtime exception class 'CallFailedRuntimeException' used for handling errors from Feign HTTP client calls, including extracting detailed error messages from JSON error responses.

classes.name: CallFailedRuntimeException
classes.description: Custom RuntimeException for handling failed Feign HTTP calls, capturing status and developer message details.

methods.name: CallFailedRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with details from a FeignException cause.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a detailed error message string based on the FeignException, including status, request URL, and error body.

methods.name: extractDeveloperMessage
methods.description: Extracts a developer-friendly error message from the FeignException's JSON content, or defaults to the exception message.
